name: Fine Crab Chunks
summary: Along Darkshore's coast, Reef Crawlers and Encrusted Tide Crawlers yield Fine Crab Chunks. Gubber Blump seeks them for his cooking.

sections.title: Fruit of the Sea
sections.body: Reef Crawlers and Encrusted Tide Crawlers roam Darkshore's shores. By the water, travelers may find them pests or dangers, while cooks prize their meat. The chunks can be boiled, broiled, fried, or stirred into stews.

faq.q: What creatures yield Fine Crab Chunks?
aliases: where do fine crab chunks drop
faq.answer: Reef Crawlers and Encrusted Tide Crawlers along Darkshore's rocky beaches and tidal shallows yield Fine Crab Chunks.

faq.q: Who wants Fine Crab Chunks in Darkshore?
faq.answer: Gubber Blump, a fisherman on Auberdine's docks, seeks Fine Crab Chunks for his crab dishes.

faq.q: Can you prepare these into actual meals?
aliases: can you cook fine crab chunks
what can you make with fine crab chunks
faq.answer: Gubber Blump collects these raw chunks rather than using them directly in a recipe. Crab meat can be baked, barbecued, boiled, broiled, fried, or mixed into salads and stews.

angles.text: Gubber Blump knows many ways to cook crab, from soups and salads to pepper rubs and Ironforge surprise crab.
Supplying the residents on Auberdine's docks helps sustain the Alliance outpost in Darkshore.
